## fixture fdr

Show fixture difficulty rating

```text
Usage: fplr fixture fdr [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -t, --team <TEAM>
  -l, --limit <LIMIT>  [default: 5]
  -f, --from <FROM>    Start from this gameweek
      --form           Adjust difficulty by current team form
      --sort-by-avg    Sort teams by average difficulty (ascending)
```

**Example**

```sh
fplr fixture fdr
```


## fixture list

Show upcoming fixtures

```text
Usage: fplr fixture list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -g, --gw <GW>   Specific Gameweek (defaults to current)
  -n, --next      Next Gameweek
  -p, --prev      Previous Gameweek
  -f, --form      Show team form for each fixture
      --xg        Show xG for each fixture (aggregated from player stats)
```

**Example**

```sh
fplr fixture list --prev
```


## fixture show

Show detailed points summary for a specific fixture

```text
Usage: fplr fixture show [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  Fixture ID
```

**Example**

```sh
fplr fixture show 72
```

## fixture swing

Show mathematically calculated Fixture Swings

```text
Usage: fplr fixture swing [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -g, --gw <GW>                Starting Gameweek (defaults to current/next)
  -w, --window <WINDOW>        Number of Gameweeks in each comparison window [default: 4]
  -t, --threshold <THRESHOLD>  Minimum average FDR difference to be considered a swing [default: 1.0]
```

**Example**

```sh
fplr fixture swing
```

```text
Fixture Swings starting at GW8 (Window: 4 GWs, Threshold: 1.0)

🟢 [Positive Swings] (Getting Easier)
Team    Before            After             Diff
------------------------------------------------
AVL     3.25 (GW8-11)     2.25 (GW12-15)    -1.00

🔴 [Negative Swings] (Getting Harder)
Team    Before            After             Diff
------------------------------------------------
MCI     2.75 (GW8-11)     3.75 (GW12-15)    +1.00
```
